response.justification: Despite Bogdan's impressive 20+ years of software engineering experience and demonstrated excellence in system design, Agile practices, and technical mentorship, this profile is fundamentally misaligned with the role's core requirements. The position requires an experienced C++ developer with industrial automation and security domain expertise; the candidate's most recent C++ work ended in 2015 (11+ years ago) and their entire career has focused on web/SaaS platforms rather than manufacturing or industrial machinery solutions. The absence of current C++ proficiency, IEC 62443 compliance expertise, IoT/industrial protocol knowledge, and manufacturing domain experience represents a disqualifying gap despite genuine strengths in other competency areas.
strengths: Extensive software engineering experience (20+ years) with proven expertise in system design, architecture, and cross-platform development
Strong track record of modern development practices (TDD, CI/CD, Agile) and demonstrated mentoring and technical leadership capabilities
Polyglot developer with versatility across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems; proven ability to learn new technologies quickly
concerns: Critical C++ expertise gap—last hands-on C++ work ended in 2015 (11+ years ago); primary career focus has been web/SaaS development in TypeScript/Node.js
No background in industrial automation, manufacturing, IoT systems, or industrial protocols (Modbus, IEC 61850, IEC 104, OPC UA); entirely SaaS/web-focused domain experience
Absence of security/compliance expertise in SDL practices and IEC 62443 industrial-cybersecurity standards; no demonstrated secure coding or threat modeling experience
